recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a focused current-build source fix that completes the FHIR-40504 terminology split in narrative and example content without adding broader optional explanatory text.
issue_request: FHIR-40504 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested adding ConceptMap mapping properties, adding ConceptMap.property.system/code handling, renaming mapAttribute-style elements to additionalAttribute/attribute, and updating $translate property/product/dependency parameters.
initial_application: Git commit 0de5092965 applied most of FHIR-40504 after FHIR-39151 commit cebd9afb99 introduced the earlier property framework, but the active ConceptMap notes retained old dependsOn.property/property-definition wording and the specimen example included additionalAttribute.system children that are not defined by the current StructureDefinition.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-40544 later confirmed the same property/additionalAttribute distinction in the R4-to-R5 change bullets, and FHIR-40636 later clarified that dependsOn/product valueCode code systems come from group.source/group.target rather than an attribute/property definition.
reconciliation: Updated source/conceptmap/conceptmap-notes.xml to refer to dependsOn.attribute and ConceptMap.additionalAttribute and to use the current group source/target code-system rule for valueCode. Removed undefined system children from the additionalAttribute declarations in source/conceptmap/conceptmap-example-specimen-type.xml.
source_changes: source/conceptmap/conceptmap-notes.xml: replaced stale dependsOn.property/property-definition prose with dependsOn.attribute, ConceptMap.additionalAttribute, and the current group source/target valueCode rule.
source/conceptmap/conceptmap-example-specimen-type.xml: removed additionalAttribute.system children because ConceptMap.additionalAttribute has no system element in the current source definition.
